# 2026-07-18 Archestimator Whole-Repo Performance & Optimization Audit

**Audit commit:** `a41a07d0143abf72289a97cd8bd023cfa9986361` (HEAD on `main`, 2026-07-18)
**Audit mode:** read-only audit + planning (no production code modified)
**Generated by:** lead ZCode agent + 4 parallel recon agents (React, D1, Worker/DO/Queue/Cron, exports/uploads/auth/observability)
**Coverage:** 12,621 tracked files classified; ~1,500 runtime-surface files audited in depth

## Read in this order

1. **`11-EXECUTIVE-SUMMARY.md`** — TL;DR; five largest risks; three best-return changes; readiness verdict; what NOT to optimize yet; one-page scorecard.
2. **`00-AUDIT-METADATA.md`** — environment, what was/wasn't measured, scope decisions.
3. **`05-FINDINGS-REGISTER.md`** — 14 actionable findings (1 P0 / 2 P1 / 8 P2 / 3 P3) + 4 rejected, each with `file:line` source, root cause, recommendation, constraints, effort, risk, dependencies, verification, and existing-plan relation.
4. **`01-EXISTING-AUDIT-RECONCILIATION.md`** — plan-by-plan status of the existing 33-plan improve-audit pack against 16 commits of drift (27 still valid, 2 verified DONE, 0 stale on core claims).
5. **`06-QUICK-WINS-AND-HIGH-LEVERAGE-CHANGES.md`** — ranked XS-M changes with priority scores.
6. **`07-OPTIMIZATION-ROADMAP.md`** — Wave 0-4 plan with dependencies, acceptance criteria, rollback, impact per item.
7. **`08-PERFORMANCE-BUDGETS-AND-REGRESSION-GATES.md`** — existing budgets ratified/revised/rejected; new budgets; CI-gate placement.
8. **`02-REPOSITORY-COVERAGE.md`** — coverage methodology and category summary.
9. **`03-RUNTIME-AND-DATAFLOW-MAP.md`** — Worker pre-routing chain, Mermaid flows for critical journeys.
10. **`04-BASELINE-METHODOLOGY-AND-RESULTS.md`** — what was MEASURED vs BLOCKED; D1 EXPLAIN candidates; scale tiers.
11. **`09-DOCUMENTATION-AND-TOOLING-DRIFT.md`** — 23 drift items classified harmless/misleading/dangerous.
12. **`10-BLOCKED-EVIDENCE-AND-AUTHORIZATION-NEEDORIZATION-NEEDED.md`** — every blocked measurement with exact command and decision unlocked.

## Headline findings (one-liners)

- **P0 — PERF-CI-001**: `.github/workflows/` is empty; README claims CI runs; no automated regression protection.
- **P1 — PERF-AUTH-001**: `disableCookieCache: true` forces 3 D1 reads per authenticated request.
- **P1 — PERF-OBS-001**: web-vitals collector emits 5-11 D1 writes/page-view (no dedup, double-fire on mobile, pagehide leak).
- **P2 — PERF-D1-001**: restore-replay issues up to 100 single-row SELECTs (existing Plan 023, confirmed current).
- **P2 — PERF-D1-002**: `reconcileActivityOutbox` has up to 1500 D1 statements per daily pass (N+1).
- **P2 — PERF-CRON-001**: 5-min cron always inserts `cron_run_events` row; ~1,152 D1 rows/day from empty sweeps.
- **P2 — PERF-CRON-002**: GlobalPresence singleton DO `broadcastTimer` prevents hibernation (cleanup leak).
- **P2 — PERF-RT-001**: no `bufferedAmount` backpressure in any DO.
- **P2 — PERF-FE-001**: virtualized row `style` prop rebuilt per render (existing Plan 022, confirmed current).
- **P2 — PERF-FE-002**: global `AppProviders` ships 8 providers to every route incl. public marketing.
- **P2 — PERF-EXP-001**: XLSX export does 2× memory copy + STORE-mode uncompressed ZIP.
- **P2 — PERF-PUB-001**: recipient invitation emails block the publication request path (existing Plan 021, confirmed current).
- **P3 — PERF-FE-003**: `useEstimateRowUpdateBroadcast` is dead code.
- **P3 — PERF-DOC-001**: provider-era perf scripts still reference Supabase/psql.
- **P3 — PERF-DOC-002**: performance budget doc has Postgres/Vercel/Supabase-era assumptions.

## Status

This is an audit deliverable. No code, migrations, configuration, dependencies, or deployment settings were changed. The entire audit lives under this folder. Implementation is gated on user authorization per AGENTS.md (build/test/browser/hosted-credential gates enumerated in `10-BLOCKED-EVIDENCE-AND-AUTHORIZATION-NEEDED.md`).
